Class AutoTimeManager

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.utility.AutoTimeManager
public class AutoTimeManager extends Object
Manages time during the 30-second FTC autonomous period.

This class is responsible for determining when the robot must stop performing normal autonomous tasks and begin its PARK operation. It also determines whether enough time remains to safely begin another task.

Each robot should create its own AutoTimeManager, because Robot 1 and Robot 2 can have different worst-case return-to-PARK times.

The PARK deadline is calculated as:

PARK deadline =
    autonomous duration
    - worst-case PARK return time
    - PARK safety margin

The class also maintains a separate timer for measuring how long the robot spends in each autonomous state.

  • Constructor Details

    • AutoTimeManager

      public AutoTimeManager(double worstCaseParkTime, double parkSafetyMargin)
      Creates an autonomous time manager for one robot.

      The supplied PARK time should be determined experimentally by testing the robot from the worst realistic autonomous positions.

      Parameters:
      worstCaseParkTime - maximum measured return-to-PARK time, in seconds
      parkSafetyMargin - additional safety time reserved for PARK, in seconds
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either time is negative, or if their sum is greater than or equal to the autonomous period

      public void startState(String stateName)
      Records the beginning of a new autonomous state.

      The state timer is reset whenever this method is called. The main autonomous timer is not affected.

      Parameters:
      stateName - name of the newly entered autonomous state

    • canStartTask

      public boolean canStartTask(double estimatedTaskTime)
      Determines whether there is enough remaining autonomous time to safely begin a proposed task.

      The calculation reserves enough time after the proposed task for both the worst-case PARK return and the PARK safety margin.

      Parameters:
      estimatedTaskTime - estimated duration of the proposed task, in seconds
      Returns:
      true if the task can safely begin; false otherwise
